summary: Norwich lower airspace radar service, including controlled airspace transits, may be unavailable due to controller shortage.
text:
NORWICH LOWER AIRSPACE RADAR SERVICE, INCLUDING CLASS D AIRSPACE 
TRANSITS, MAY NOT BE AVBL DUE CONTROLLER SHORTAGE. PILOTS ARE 
ENCOURAGED TO MAKE USE OF THE FREQ MONITORING CODE IF REMAINING 
OUTSIDE CONTROLLED AIRSPACE AND TO CARRY AND USE ELECTRONIC 
CONSPICUITY DEVICES.
